issues.description: Class: de.tum.cit.ase.Farm — The problem statement and the provided template expect a public no-argument constructor Farm() that initializes the internal ArrayList. The problem statement explicitly instructs to "Initialize the ArrayList in a constructor with no arguments" and the template Main uses `new Farm()` (no-arg) to create a Farm instance. The solution implementation, however, only provides a constructor with a single int parameter: `public Farm(int initialCapacity)`. This API mismatch will cause code that calls `new Farm()` (as shown in the template Main and as required by the exercise text) to fail to compile against the solution and will confuse students about which constructor they should implement.
